title: Meri jaan sakina
body:
Haye sakina...... 4
Baba tere sadqe aaye meri jaan sakina
Ho jau teri pyas pe qurbaan sakina
Kuch pal me ujad jaega amma ka bharaghar
Hoga nahi sina tujhe baba ka mayassar
Duniya teri hojaegi viraan sakina
Rona nahi bacchi meri wada ye karo tum
Kuch der ko khaime mai meri jaan chalo tum
Baba pe karo itna to ehsaan sakina
Sine pe sulaunga mai loree suna kar
Chahunga tujhe beti aakhon me basa kar
Ye lamha karo mujpe tum aasan sakina
Asghar ki judaai ka hai daag jigar me
Bikhra hua qasim hai baba ki nazar me
Bhula nahi akbar ki azaan sakina
Aagosh mei amma ki baitha karo beti
Kuch paal me badal jaegi taqdeer tumhari
Baba hai kuch ghadi ka mehmaan sakina
Shabbir jo maktal ki janib hai sidhare
Ro ro ke sakina ye Aashoor pukare
Bin tere kya jiyegi teri jaan sakina
